sum: Caleb Williams threw a 6-yard touchdown pass to Rome Odunze with 3 seconds left, and Chicago beat Detroit 39-35 on Thanksgiving to move into first place in the NFC North. Odunze got both feet down and the catch was upheld on review.

Williams finished 30 of 44 for 345 yards and two touchdowns, and kept the winning drive alive with a fourth-and-1 run. Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 205 yards and three touchdowns for the Lions, including a 70-yarder, per the AP.
Detroit had led 35-24 before Williams hit Odunze for a 41-yard score. The Bears defense then stopped Gibbs on fourth-and-4 at the Chicago 33 with just over two minutes left.

said.t: Said Odunze was not the first read on the winning throw and credited Williams and the offensive line for giving him a clean pocket.
Said the comeback showed the team’s character and resilience.
Said his team made plenty of good plays but could not make the one more it needed to close the game, and praised how Gibbs found running lanes.
Said he was fine after getting an X-ray after the game; the Chicago Sun-Times reported it was likely a bruise from an awkward fall.

con: Campbell passed on a possible 50-yard field goal that would have put Detroit up six and went for it on fourth-and-4. T.J. Edwards stopped Gibbs short, and Chicago scored on the next possession, per the AP.
Earlier, a Williams strip-sack in the end zone became a safety when Bears tackle Darnell Wright was ruled to have illegally batted the loose ball, the Bears' recap said.

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: No. 5 Texas grinds out a 16-6 win at Texas A&M and books an SEC title game rematch with Georgia
stories.dek: Gianni Spetic kicked three field goals and the Longhorns never trailed, winning the rivalry for a fourth straight time.
body: Texas beat Texas A&M 16-6 in College Station on Friday night to clinch a spot in the SEC Championship Game, per the AP. The Longhorns never trailed, though the AP noted they struggled to put the Aggies away.

Arch Manning was 18 of 34 for 143 yards, his lowest passing total of the season, according to the AP. His lone touchdown was a 3-yard throw to Cam Coleman early in the second quarter that finished a 12-play, 88-yard drive for a 10-0 lead. A tipped Manning pass was intercepted in the end zone by Tawfiq Byard with about 11 minutes left.

Kicker Gianni Spetic supplied the rest with field goals of 54, 33 and 42 yards. Texas A&M's points came on two David Olano field goals, a 52-yarder at the end of the first half and a 35-yarder in the third quarter. The Aggies punted on their first four possessions, and Jelani McDonald recovered a Mario Craver fumble on A&M's second snap of the second half.

Brady Hart threw for 201 yards for Texas A&M in his second start since Marcel Reed was benched. The Aggies' season ends at 4-8 (1-8 SEC) with a fifth straight loss, a year after they entered this game unbeaten and lost 27-17.

Texas (10-2, 7-2) has won six straight and will face No. 1 Georgia in Atlanta on Dec. 5, a rematch of the 2024 title game the Bulldogs won 22-19 in overtime, per the AP. The Longhorns locked up the spot after Ole Miss beat Mississippi State 41-17 earlier Friday.

quiz.q: Who caught Arch Manning's touchdown pass?
quiz.why: Manning hit Cam Coleman from 3 yards out in the second quarter, per the AP.

quiz.q: How many field goals did Gianni Spetic make?
quiz.why: Spetic made kicks of 54, 33 and 42 yards.

name: GIANNI
SPETIC

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: No. 25 Louisville hands No. 9 Tennessee its first loss, 84-64, and reaches the Players Era 16 final
stories.dek: Seth Trimble scored 17 as the Cardinals ran away from the previously unbeaten Vols in Las Vegas.
body: Louisville beat Tennessee 84-64 in the Players Era 16 bracket final at Michelob Ultra Arena in Las Vegas on Friday night, per WLKY. Tennessee came in 7-0 and leading the SEC.

Seth Trimble led Louisville with 17 points on 5-of-9 shooting, WLKY reported. The Cardinals entered 5-1, with their only loss coming against Memphis, and had beaten No. 13 St. John's earlier in the event.
Louisville plays for the Players Era 16 championship on Saturday night against the winner of Creighton and No. 22 Gonzaga, who were playing late Friday.
name: SETH
TRIMBLE

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: Two days after cutting Aaron Rodgers, the Steelers rout first-place Denver 27-5 on Black Friday
stories.dek: Mason Rudolph was efficient in his first start of the season, and Pittsburgh's defense scored twice off Bo Nix turnovers.
body: The Pittsburgh Steelers beat the Denver Broncos 27-5 at a rain-soaked Acrisure Stadium on Friday, leading from start to finish and taking a 24-5 lead into halftime, per ESPN. It was Pittsburgh's first game since releasing Aaron Rodgers.

Mason Rudolph, making his first start of the season, went 9 of 15 for 142 yards and a touchdown, according to Yardbarker's box score summary. ESPN noted he completed his first five passes for 94 yards, including a 58-yard catch-and-run by rookie Germie Bernard that set up a 22-yard touchdown to DK Metcalf.

The defense did the rest. A Bo Nix fumble at the Denver 6 was recovered in the end zone for a touchdown, and Jalen Ramsey returned an interception for a score just before halftime, the second pick-six of his career and his first since his 2016 rookie year, per ESPN. Ramsey later broke up a third-down pass that led to a missed 53-yard field goal by Wil Lutz.

Nix finished 22 of 40 for 169 yards with two interceptions, his seventh career game with at least two picks, ESPN reported. Denver ran for under 4 yards per carry for the ninth time this season. Pittsburgh outgained the Broncos 247-205, and Rico Dowdle ran 11 times for 71 yards.

The context: Rodgers was released Wednesday after going on The Pat McAfee Show and accusing coach Mike McCarthy of falling asleep in a quarterback meeting, among other complaints, and he cleared waivers Thursday to become a free agent, per Yahoo Sports. McCarthy had defended his decision to bench Rodgers.

Pittsburgh improved to 7-4 (5-0 at home) and ESPN Analytics now gives the Steelers a 92% chance to make the playoffs. Denver fell to 8-3 but still leads the AFC West. The Steelers host Houston on Dec. 6; the Broncos host Miami the same day.
name: JALEN
RAMSEY

quiz.q: Who returned an interception for a touchdown before halftime?
quiz.why: Ramsey's pick-six made it 24-5 at the break, per ESPN.

quiz.q: What was Pittsburgh's home record after the win?
quiz.why: The Steelers are 5-0 at home and 7-4 overall.

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: Tyler Bass hits a 57-yarder at the gun after a partial punt block as Bills beat Chiefs 13-10 in the rain
stories.dek: Buffalo won its seventh straight and its first home Thanksgiving game ever, despite Josh Allen throwing for just 81 yards.
body: The Buffalo Bills beat the Kansas City Chiefs 13-10 on Thanksgiving night at Highmark Stadium, winning on Tyler Bass's 57-yard field goal as time expired in cold rain and swirling wind, per ESPN. Buffalo is 10-1 and has won seven in a row; Kansas City fell to 8-3.

The winning drive barely existed. Bills linebacker Joe Andreessen got a hand on Matt Araiza's final punt, and Greg Dortch returned it 17 yards to the Kansas City 39, according to BuffaloBills.com. Bass had tied the game 10-10 with a 54-yarder early in the fourth quarter.

Per BuffaloBills.com, Bass is the first kicker in NFL history to make both a game-tying and a game-winning field goal of 54 or more yards in the fourth quarter of the same game. It was also the Bills' first home Thanksgiving win in franchise history.

Kansas City had its chance: Harrison Butker missed a 46-yard try wide right with about six minutes left. ESPN noted Butker is tied for the league lead with nine missed kicks this season. Araiza also had a rough night, with a dropped ball and several shanked punts.

Josh Allen went 10 of 21 for 81 yards with two red-zone interceptions and an 18.3 passer rating, per ESPN, which said it was his first career game with multiple red-zone picks. Patrick Mahomes was 16 of 29 for 174 yards. Rookie Emmett Johnson, starting for the injured Kenneth Walker III, scored on a 1-yard run and became the first Chiefs rookie with a touchdown in five straight games.

Bills punter Tommy Doman Jr. pinned Kansas City inside its 10 twice in the final two minutes. The Chiefs punted seven times, their most in a loss with Mahomes starting, ESPN said. Kansas City lost right guard Trey Smith and receiver Jalen Royals to ankle injuries, per Chiefs.com. "We just came up short," Mahomes said.
name: TYLER
BASS

quiz.q: How long was Tyler Bass's game-winning field goal?
quiz.why: Bass hit from 57 as time expired.

quiz.q: How many passing yards did Josh Allen have?
quiz.why: Allen was 10 of 21 for 81 yards, per ESPN.

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: Hank Brown scores four touchdowns as No. 13 Iowa routs Nebraska and stays in the Big Ten and playoff hunt
stories.dek: The Hawkeyes reached 10 wins and have now won 11 of the last 12 meetings with the Huskers.
body: No. 13 Iowa beat Nebraska 31-7 at Kinnick Stadium on Black Friday, scoring 14 points in the fourth quarter to pull away, according to the AP recap on ESPN. Iowa is 10-2 (7-2 Big Ten); Nebraska finished the regular season 7-5.
Quarterback Hank Brown ran for three touchdowns, from 14, 6 and 29 yards, and threw a 9-yard score to DJ Vonnahme. He finished with 173 passing yards and 48 rushing yards, per ESPN.

Nebraska's only touchdown was a 21-yard run by Jamal Rule, who ran for 106 yards. The Huskers recovered a muffed punt in the third quarter while down 10-7 but were stopped on downs at the Iowa 35. It came a week after Nebraska beat Ohio State to snap a 31-game losing streak against ranked teams.

Interesting numbers, per ESPN: Iowa has won five straight by a combined 147-41, has not allowed a second-half point in three straight games, and leads the nation in scoring defense. Iowa outgained Nebraska 329-260.

Iowa still needs help to reach the Big Ten title game, with UCLA at 7-1 in conference play and Indiana and Oregon at 6-2, per ESPN's standings. Kirk Ferentz said winning 10 games in a year is an accomplishment.
name: HANK
BROWN

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: No. 20 Florida beats Florida State for a third straight year and finishes 8-4
stories.dek: Jadan Baugh joined Emmitt Smith and Errict Rhett in the Gators record book, and Patrick Durkin made all four field goals.
body: Florida beat Florida State 26-10 in Tallahassee on Friday and never trailed, according to OnlyGators and ESPN's scoreboard. The Gators finished the regular season 8-4, their best record since 2020, and have won three straight and six of the last eight in the rivalry.

Running back Jadan Baugh had 97 total yards and a touchdown on 20 touches. Per OnlyGators, he is the first Gator to run for 1,000 yards in back-to-back seasons and the third to reach 1,000 twice, after Emmitt Smith and Errict Rhett.

Quarterback Aaron Philo went 9 of 12 for 127 yards, including a 65-yard completion to Eric Singleton Jr., before leaving with an undisclosed injury. Tramell Jones Jr. replaced him and ran for a touchdown. Kicker Patrick Durkin went 4 for 4 on field goals.

Stat notes, per OnlyGators: Florida has scored in 485 straight games, an NCAA record, and won by 10 or more in back-to-back trips to Tallahassee for the first time since 1974. The all-time series stands at 40-28-2 Florida.
OnlyGators expects Florida to land just outside the top 12 of the CFP rankings; the Gators will wait for a bowl assignment.
name: JADAN
BAUGH

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: Chauncey Wiggins hits five threes as No. 22 Gonzaga beats Baylor in Las Vegas
stories.dek: The Zags' bench outscored Baylor's 34-9, and Gonzaga now meets Creighton for a spot in the Players Era 16 championship.
body: No. 22 Gonzaga beat Baylor 72-64 in the Players Era 16 semifinals at T-Mobile Arena on Thursday night, per the AP recap on GoZags.com. Gonzaga led 36-32 at halftime and pushed the lead to 20 with about eight minutes left.

Chauncey Wiggins scored 19 points on 7-of-11 shooting, including 5 of 7 from three. Braden Huff added 12 and Izan Almansa went 5 for 5 for 11 points. The Spokesman-Review noted Gonzaga's bench outscored Baylor's 34-9 while leading scorer Davis Fogle had a quiet night.
Baylor shot 35.1% and 5 of 25 from three, and went more than six minutes without a point in the second half. Isaac Williams led the Bears with 20 points.

Gonzaga (5-1) met Creighton (6-1) late Friday; Creighton beat TCU 95-87 in its semifinal. Baylor (5-2) lost the third-place game to TCU. The winner advances to Saturday's Players Era 16 championship against No. 25 Louisville, which beat No. 9 Tennessee 84-64, per WLKY.
name: CHAUNCEY
WIGGINS

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: Cowboys blow a 21-point lead to the Eagles on Thanksgiving and fall to 3-2 this season when up 14+ in the fourth quarter
stories.dek: Jake Elliott's 59-yard field goal with two seconds left finished the largest Thanksgiving comeback in NFL history. The rest of the league is 72-0-1 when leading by 14 or more in the fourth this season.
body: The Philadelphia Eagles beat the Dallas Cowboys 39-38 at AT&T Stadium on Thanksgiving, winning on Jake Elliott's 59-yard field goal with two seconds left. Dallas had led 31-10 late in the third quarter, when ESPN Analytics gave the Cowboys a 99.4% chance to win.

The stat everyone is talking about: Dallas is now 3-2 this season when leading by at least 14 points in the fourth quarter, according to ESPN Research. Every other NFL team combined is 72-0-1 in that spot. Per the Elias Sports Bureau, the Cowboys are the first team in NFL history to lose two home games in one season while up 14 or more in the fourth. Before November, Dallas had been 202-0-1 at home in that situation across its entire history, CBS Sports noted.

The first collapse came Nov. 1, a 33-30 overtime loss to Arizona after leading 24-10 with 14:20 to play. The Cowboys have now lost to three backup quarterbacks this season: Jalon Daniels, Gardner Minshew and Joe Milton, a former Dallas practice-squad quarterback.

How it slipped away: a blocked punt returned for a touchdown cut it to 31-24 with 13:46 left. Dak Prescott's touchdown scramble made it 38-24, but Milton ran for a 15-yard score, Brandon Aubrey missed a 40-yard field goal, and Milton hit Makai Lemon for a 24-yard touchdown to make it 38-36. Philadelphia missed both two-point tries.

Dallas then went for it on fourth-and-1 from the Eagles 39 with 55 seconds left, and Prescott was sacked for a 9-yard loss. Head coach Brian Schottenheimer said he wanted the ball in his quarterback's hands. A pass interference call on Markquese Bell moved Philadelphia into range for Elliott.

Milton threw for 331 yards and three touchdowns, two of them deep shots to DeVonta Smith, who had 11 catches for 200 yards. Philadelphia played without Jalen Hurts and lost Saquon Barkley, Cooper DeJean and Dallas Goedert during the game.

The controversy: Jerry Jones called the losses "damning" but said he does not plan coaching changes, per ESPN. Schottenheimer is 12-16-1, and the Cowboys are 5-7 despite averaging 31.3 points per game, the second most in the league. They are also 4-4 when scoring 30 or more, tying the NFL record for such losses in a season. ESPN puts their playoff odds at 12.5%. Dallas plays at Seattle on Dec. 7.
name: JAKE
ELLIOTT

quiz.q: What is Dallas's record this season when leading by 14+ in the fourth quarter?
quiz.why: Dallas is 3-2; the rest of the NFL is 72-0-1, per ESPN Research.

quiz.q: Who kicked the winning field goal?
quiz.why: Elliott hit from 59 yards with two seconds left.

quiz.q: Which team beat Dallas in the first blown 14-point home lead this season?
quiz.why: Arizona won 33-30 in overtime on Nov. 1.

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: Caleb Williams hits Rome Odunze with 3 seconds left as Bears stun Lions 39-35 to take first in the NFC North
stories.dek: Chicago trailed by 11 midway through the fourth quarter, then scored twice to win in Detroit on Thanksgiving. The Bears are 9-2 and have won six straight.
body: The Chicago Bears beat the Detroit Lions 39-35 at Ford Field on Thanksgiving, winning on a 6-yard touchdown pass from Caleb Williams to Rome Odunze with 3 seconds left, CBS Chicago reported. It was Chicago's first lead of the game, and it broke a first-place tie in the NFC North.

Detroit led 35-24 after Jahmyr Gibbs broke a 70-yard touchdown run, his third score of the day. Chicago answered with a three-play drive capped by a 41-yard Williams touchdown pass to Odunze, and Williams ran in the two-point conversion to make it 35-32.

With 2:17 left, linebacker T.J. Edwards stopped Gibbs a yard after the catch on fourth-and-4 at the Chicago 32, giving the ball back to the Bears, according to the team's recap. Williams finished 30 of 44 for 345 yards and two touchdowns, per CBS Chicago.

Gibbs ran for 205 yards on 21 carries and added five catches for 42 yards. Kyle Monangai scored twice on the ground for Chicago and D'Andre Swift had a 30-yard touchdown run. Detroit's six-game win streak ended and the Lions fell to 8-3.
Bears tight end Colston Loveland was carted off with a knee injury in the first quarter and did not return. Chicago hosts Jacksonville next.

quiz.q: Who caught the winning touchdown for Chicago?
quiz.why: Williams found Odunze from 6 yards out with 3 seconds left.

quiz.q: How many rushing yards did Jahmyr Gibbs have?
quiz.why: Gibbs ran for 205 yards on 21 carries; 247 was his total from scrimmage.

quiz.q: Who made the fourth-down stop on Gibbs with 2:17 left?
quiz.why: Linebacker T.J. Edwards stopped Gibbs short on fourth-and-4.

name: CALEB
WILLIAMS

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: Cincinnati hands Georgia its first loss, 83-81, with a block at the buzzer
stories.dek: Tyler Tejada and Myles Colvin scored 23 each, and Jayden Hastings sealed it by blocking a putback as time ran out in Kissimmee.
body: Cincinnati beat Georgia 83-81 on Thanksgiving Day in the ESPN Events Invitational in Kissimmee, Florida, handing the Bulldogs their first loss of the season.

Tyler Tejada scored a season-high 23 points and Myles Colvin also had 23, all of Colvin's in the first half. MJ Collins Jr. added 16. The Bearcats scored 50 points before halftime and made 12 of 22 three-pointers.

Georgia rallied in the second half and got the ball back down two with 18.1 seconds left after a Cincinnati shot-clock violation. Blue Cain missed a 3-pointer, James Scott grabbed the rebound, and Cincinnati center Jayden Hastings blocked Scott's follow-up at the buzzer.
Cain led Georgia with 18 points, 7 rebounds and 5 assists; Kanon Catchings and Brady Dunlap had 15 each. Both teams are now 6-1. Georgia plays UCF on Friday.

quiz.q: Who blocked Georgia's final putback attempt?
quiz.why: Cincinnati center Jayden Hastings blocked James Scott's follow-up as time expired.

quiz.q: Where was the game played?
quiz.why: It was part of the ESPN Events Invitational in Kissimmee, Florida.

stories.label: UNCONFIRMED
name: DEION
SANDERS
stories.title: Report: Deion Sanders could be out at Colorado this weekend, win or lose
stories.dek: Unconfirmed. Media personality Phillip Dukes cited one source; Sanders says he is not losing sleep over it.
body: Phillip Dukes said Wednesday that a source he called very credible told him Deion Sanders could be fired by Colorado this weekend regardless of the result, according to The Comeback, which was republished by Yahoo Sports.
Dukes also said a replacement could be announced as soon as next week and named New Mexico coach Jason Eck as the leading candidate. He acknowledged the report rests on one source.
Sanders told reporters he is not losing sleep over his job status. Colorado has not commented on the report, and nothing has been confirmed by the school.

Speaking Tuesday, Sanders said he is happy with his life and would move on to what he called God's next assignment if his time in Boulder ends, USA TODAY reported via Yahoo Sports. Colorado (4-7) hosts UCF on Saturday in its last regular-season game. If the school fired him after that, it would owe him about $26 million, paid monthly through 2029, according to the same report.

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: Rams beat Packers 26-13 as Blake Corum runs for a career-high 184 yards
stories.dek: The Rams shut out Green Bay after halftime in the NFL's first Thanksgiving Eve game. Micah Parsons got his first sack back from injury.
body: The Los Angeles Rams beat the Green Bay Packers 26-13 on Wednesday night. Blake Corum carried 32 times for a career-high 184 yards and scored the go-ahead touchdown on the Rams' first drive of the second half.

The game was tied 13-13 at halftime. Kyren Williams scored the Rams' first touchdown on a 7-yard run, and Jordan Love answered with a 6-yard touchdown pass to Christian Watson. After the break, the Rams defense held Green Bay scoreless, and cornerback Emmanuel Forbes Jr. intercepted Love late to seal it.
It is the Rams' fifth win in a row, moving them to 7-4 and ahead of the Packers in the NFC playoff race.
Micah Parsons, active for the first time since his knee injury, sacked Matthew Stafford in the second quarter, his first sack of the season.
name: BLAKE
CORUM

stories.label: DRAMA
name: SEAN
STRICKLAND
stories.title: Sean Strickland says the UFC, not him, picks his next fight date
stories.dek: The middleweight champion answered a fan account that accused him of holding up the division. No opponent or date is booked.
body: UFC middleweight champion Sean Strickland replied on X to a fan account that accused him of stalling the 185-pound division, saying the promotion sets his fight dates, not him, according to MiddleEasy.
He did not name a challenger or a date. Nassourdine Imavov publicly offered in October to put up $500,000 of his own money if Strickland beat him in January, but no such fight has been booked.

The exchange follows Strickland's October complaints about his UFC pay. He has also floated a move to light heavyweight and a possible boxing match with Jake Paul, both of which remain ideas, not deals.

stories.label: BREAKING
name: AARON
RODGERS
stories.title: Steelers waive Aaron Rodgers hours after he criticizes Mike McCarthy on national TV
stories.dek: Pittsburgh benched him Tuesday night; he went on The Pat McAfee Show Wednesday and was waived that afternoon.
body: The Steelers waived quarterback Aaron Rodgers on Wednesday, ESPN and NFL.com report. Because it is past the trade deadline, any team can claim him; if nobody does he becomes an unrestricted free agent.

The team had announced late Tuesday that Rodgers would be inactive for Friday's game against the Broncos, with Mason Rudolph set to start. On The Pat McAfee Show, Rodgers said he would not return to Pittsburgh and accused coach Mike McCarthy of dozing in meetings. He said he learned of the benching from tight end Pat Freiermuth.

ESPN reports that multiple league sources told it Rodgers' account was accurate. NFL.com, citing Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter, says Pittsburgh had planned to keep him before the interview changed things.
Neither source reported a formal Steelers statement on the move. The Steelers host Denver on Friday at 2:00 PM CT.
Update: Rodgers went unclaimed and cleared waivers Thursday, making him a free agent, per Yahoo Sports. Pittsburgh beat Denver 27-5 in its first game without him.

quiz.q: Which team waived Aaron Rodgers?
quiz.why: ESPN and NFL.com report the Steelers waived him on Wednesday.

videos.t: Breaking down the timing of the Steelers benching Aaron Rodgers

stories.label: BREAKING
name: BRIAN
ORTEGA
stories.title: Brian Ortega retires after decision loss to Dan Hooker at UFC Qatar
stories.dek: The former featherweight title contender, 33, says he made the call before he even walked out on Nov. 21.
body: Brian Ortega has stepped away from MMA. The Body Lock reports he told coach Henry Hooft on the morning of his UFC Qatar fight that he was done, and that the decision was already made before Hooft asked whether nerves were talking.
Ortega then lost a unanimous decision to Dan Hooker on the Prochazka vs. Stirling card. He was cautious through the first two rounds before opening up in the third.

He explained the decision on the post-fight show, saying he has nothing left to prove, is no longer driven by anger and no longer wants to hurt people. The 33-year-old Southern California native is a former UFC featherweight title contender.

stories.label: BREAKING
name: LEBRON
JAMES
stories.title: LeBron James becomes the oldest player with a triple-double as 76ers end Heat's streak
stories.dek: 25 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds at 41 in a 111-104 NBA Cup win. Philadelphia lost Jaylen Brown to a hamstring injury.
body: LeBron James had 25 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds as the Philadelphia 76ers beat the Miami Heat 111-104 on Wednesday. At 41 years and 330 days, he is now the oldest player in NBA history to record a triple-double, Yahoo Sports reported.

The win snapped Miami's seven-game winning streak. A Heat win would have clinched their NBA Cup group; instead Miami fell to 2-1 in Cup play. Tyrese Maxey led Philadelphia with 30 points and VJ Edgecombe added 18.

The Sixers played without Joel Embiid, who was out sick, and lost Jaylen Brown when he re-aggravated his left hamstring in the second quarter. CBS Sports, citing USA Today's Ky Carlin, reported that Brown will get imaging, with an update from the team expected Thursday. He recently missed two games with the same injury.
Giannis Antetokounmpo led Miami with 32 points and 14 rebounds.

quiz.q: How old was LeBron James when he set the record for oldest triple-double?
quiz.why: He was 41 years and 330 days old.

quiz.q: Whose seven-game winning streak did the 76ers end?
quiz.why: The 111-104 win ended Miami's seven-game streak.

stories.label: DEVELOPING
name: LAMELO
BALL
stories.title: LaMelo Ball hurts his ankle late in Timberwolves' win at Oklahoma City
stories.dek: No official word yet, but a report says he was upbeat in the locker room after the 113-106 victory.
body: LaMelo Ball left Minnesota's 113-106 win over Oklahoma City on Wednesday after his ankle buckled late in the fourth quarter. The Big Lead reports he landed on a defender's foot while contesting a shot and was helped off the floor.
Ball had 19 points, eight assists and seven rebounds before the injury. The team has not given an update on his status.

The Athletic's Jon Krawczynski reported Ball was in good spirits afterward, joking with teammates, which The Big Lead read as a sign he may have avoided a serious injury. Minnesota is already without Anthony Edwards, who is out with no timetable to return before well after Christmas.

stories.label: BREAKING
name: KEVIN
DURANT
stories.title: Kevin Durant becomes the fifth player to reach 33,000 points as Rockets beat Suns
stories.dek: The 38-year-old scored 20 in Houston's 116-104 win on Wednesday, a night that also saw Dillon Brooks ejected after a run-in with Durant.
body: Kevin Durant reached 33,000 career points on Wednesday night as the Houston Rockets beat the Phoenix Suns 116-104. He finished with 20 points.
According to Yahoo Sports, Durant is just the fifth player in NBA history to get there, joining LeBron James, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Karl Malone and Kobe Bryant.
Alperen Sengun added a triple-double of 23 points, 11 rebounds and 11 assists, his 15th, which moved him past Hakeem Olajuwon for second-most in Rockets history.
Late in the game, Suns guard Dillon Brooks was ejected after picking up a second technical foul following a confrontation with Durant. Houston is now 14-5.

stories.label: CONTROVERSY
stories.title: Steelers stand by McCarthy as sources back Rodgers' account
stories.dek: Reporters say Pittsburgh's front office supports the coach even as league sources corroborate the complaints.
body: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Jeremy Fowler report, citing sources, that the Steelers organization fully supports Mike McCarthy and he stays as head coach. McCarthy told reporters he would not discuss private talks with Rodgers, said he believes he is the right man for the job, and confirmed the decision to bench Rodgers was his. He denied holding a grudge from their Green Bay days.

Meanwhile ESPN's Brooke Pryor and Adam Schefter cite sources saying Rodgers' version of events held up. NFL Network's Rapoport and Mike Garafolo report that Rodgers wanted to take over offensive play calling and McCarthy declined. Jane Slater reports sources describing similar concerns about McCarthy during his time in Dallas.
These details come from anonymous sources and have not been confirmed on the record by the team.

videos.t: Aaron Rodgers goes off on Mike McCarthy after his benching
videos.by: Pat McAfee Show clip, as titled on YouTube

stories.label: DRAMA
name: NAVAJO
STIRLING
stories.title: Navajo Stirling won't get a title shot against teammate Carlos Ulberg, City Kickboxing coach says
stories.dek: Eugene Bareman says the gym's long-standing rule against teammates fighting each other still stands.
body: City Kickboxing head coach Eugene Bareman says light heavyweight champion Carlos Ulberg will not defend his title against gym-mate Navajo Stirling, The Body Lock reported.
Bareman said the New Zealand gym has always kept teammates from fighting one another, and that years of training together matter more to them than a title opportunity.
Stirling knocked out Jiri Prochazka in the main event at UFC Qatar last Saturday, his second knockout of a former UFC champion after beating Jan Blachowicz in August.
Ulberg won the vacant title at UFC 327 in April by knocking out Prochazka, but tore his ACL in that fight. He had knee surgery and is aiming to return in early 2027.

poll.q: Should teammates ever fight for a UFC title?

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: Stirling knocks out Prochazka in Round 2
stories.dek: The unbeaten light heavyweight finished the former champion with a right hand at 4:58.
body: Navajo Stirling (12-0) knocked out former champion Jiri Prochazka at 4:58 of Round 2 at UFC Qatar.
It was Prochazka's second straight knockout loss. Jan Blachowicz has already called Stirling out.

quiz.q: Who did Navajo Stirling knock out at UFC Qatar?
quiz.why: Stirling finished former champion Jiri Prochazka.

quiz.why: It came at 4:58 of Round 2.

stories.label: ANALYSIS
stories.title: CFP rankings: Georgia stays No. 1, Utah is the lone unbeaten, Alabama falls to No. 6
stories.dek: The committee's fourth rankings shook up the top ten heading into rivalry week.
body: Georgia is No. 1 for the third straight week, its 18th week overall at the top, second-most in the CFP era behind Alabama's 24.
Utah (11-0) is the only undefeated team left in the FBS and sits at No. 2. Texas is No. 3, Notre Dame No. 4 and Tennessee No. 5.
Alabama dropped from No. 3 to No. 6, UCLA fell from No. 4 to No. 9 after its first loss, and Indiana fell from No. 8 to No. 14.

quiz.q: Which team is the only undefeated team left in the FBS?
quiz.why: Utah is 11-0 and sits at No. 2.

quiz.q: Where did Alabama fall in the latest CFP rankings?
quiz.why: Alabama dropped from No. 3 to No. 6.

stories.label: DEVELOPING
stories.title: Prates vs. Morales for the interim welterweight title at UFC 336
stories.dek: Islam Makhachev is out; the event is Jan. 30 in Toronto.
body: Carlos Prates will meet unbeaten Michael Morales (19-0) for the interim welterweight title on Jan. 30 in Toronto.
Makhachev backed out and is expected to return after Ramadan in 2027. Gable Steveson is also on the card.

quiz.q: Who does Carlos Prates fight for the interim welterweight title?
quiz.why: Prates meets the unbeaten Michael Morales (19-0).

quiz.q: Where is UFC 336 being held?
quiz.why: UFC 336 is Jan. 30 in Toronto.

stories.label: DEBATE
stories.title: Lakers stand alone atop the West at 15-3 after Portland hands the Spurs a fourth loss
stories.dek: The Trail Blazers beat San Antonio 116-111 on Wednesday night, breaking the tie at the top of the conference.
body: Portland beat San Antonio 116-111 on Wednesday night, dropping the Spurs to 15-4 and leaving the Lakers alone at the top of the Western Conference at 15-3. The Trail Blazers improved to 12-6.

The two had been tied after both won on Nov. 23: the Spurs 123-107 in Sacramento and the Lakers 109-94 over Utah. ESPN's Dave McMenamin reported that De'Aaron Fox was ruled out about 90 minutes before the Sacramento game.
Behind them, the Timberwolves, Rockets and Grizzlies are all 14-5 after wins on Wednesday. In the East, the 76ers lead at 15-4, with the Celtics and Knicks at 12-6.

quiz.q: What is the Lakers' record after Wednesday's games?
quiz.why: The Lakers are 15-3; the Spurs fell to 15-4 with a loss at Portland.

stories.label: CONTROVERSY
stories.title: Report: Clippers' Lawrence Frank and Steve Ballmer both suspended
stories.dek: Rival teams are skeptical the Clippers will do much at the trade deadline.
body: Hoops Rumors, citing Jake Fischer of The Stein Line, reports that rival teams doubt the Clippers will do much of significance on the trade market with head of basketball operations Lawrence Frank and owner Steve Ballmer both suspended.
Marc Stein reported earlier this week that the Clippers are widely viewed as a certain seller ahead of the deadline. The Clippers are 4-12.

On the Nov. 23 Hoop Collective podcast, ESPN's Tim MacMahon said several Clippers veterans on expiring deals are expected to be available, and the team will discuss nearly anyone except Keaton Wagler.
The sources VAULT reviewed did not include details on the suspensions.

stories.label: TRADE ALERT
stories.title: Rumor: Raptors, Warriors, Hawks seen as teams to watch if Anthony Davis becomes available
stories.dek: Unconfirmed. The Wizards reportedly have no imminent plans to move him.
body: Per Jake Fischer of The Stein Line, the Raptors, Warriors and Hawks are teams to watch if Washington makes Anthony Davis available.
The Wizards reportedly have no imminent plans to do so. This is a rumor and has not been confirmed by either team.

stories.label: DEBATE
stories.title: Lakers fans push back on the team's new partnership with Kalshi
stories.dek: Should NBA teams partner with prediction markets?
body: The Los Angeles Lakers drew criticism from their own fans after announcing a new partnership with Kalshi.

stories.label: DRAMA
stories.title: Hokit says his vision is still blurry after the eye poke against Gane
stories.dek: He also says he regrets not fouling back.
body: Josh Hokit says his vision has not recovered from the eye poke in his title loss to Ciryl Gane at UFC 334.
Gane won 48-47 on all three scorecards.

stories.label: BREAKING
stories.title: UFC releases Jandiroba, Michael Page and the Basharat brothers
stories.dek: The cuts include a former strawweight title challenger.
body: The UFC released former strawweight title challenger Virna Jandiroba, Michael Page, Farid Basharat and Javid Basharat.

stories.label: CONTROVERSY
stories.title: Manon Fiorot suspended three months after positive ostarine test
stories.dek: The UFC said she cooperated fully.
body: Manon Fiorot tested positive for low levels of ostarine and is suspended from Oct. 19 to Jan. 19. The UFC said she cooperated fully.

stories.label: DEVELOPING
stories.title: Stephen Curry could be nearing a return for the Warriors
stories.dek: The report is early; no return date is set.
body: EssentiallySports reports that Warriors star Stephen Curry could be nearing his return from injury. No return date was given.

stories.label: DEVELOPING
stories.title: Rivalry Week: No. 1 Georgia hosts Georgia Tech, No. 2 Utah can finish unbeaten
stories.dek: The regular season wraps up this weekend with a full slate of rivalry games.
body: Early results: No. 11 Texas Tech beat TCU 48-27 on Thanksgiving for its 11th win, per ESPN and Texas Tech Athletics. On Friday, No. 13 Iowa beat Nebraska 31-7 and No. 20 Florida won 26-10 at Florida State.

Georgia hosts Georgia Tech on Saturday at 3:30 PM ET on ABC and is a 35.5-point favorite. Georgia Tech has allowed at least 34 points in seven games and may start a third-string quarterback because of injuries.
No. 2 Utah can finish the regular season undefeated against West Virginia. AP's picks have Utah winning 42-21.

Friday night, No. 5 Texas won 16-6 at Texas A&M to clinch an SEC title game date with Georgia, per the AP. No. 3 Notre Dame is at Syracuse, whose starting quarterback Steve Angeli is out against his former team with an injury.
Also on the Saturday slate: Auburn at Alabama, USC at UCLA, Louisville at Kentucky, and Purdue at Indiana.

stories.label: DEBATE
stories.title: Michigan at Ohio State: two disappointing seasons, one huge rivalry
stories.dek: Both teams are out of the playoff and Big Ten title picture, and both have lost three of their last four.
body: Michigan visits Ohio State on Saturday at noon ET on Fox. Ohio State is a 10.5-point favorite.

CBS Sports says both teams are eliminated from the Big Ten title and College Football Playoff pictures. ESPN reports the Buckeyes and Wolverines each lost three of their next four games after an early-October high point.
Ohio State quarterback Julian Sayin has not played since an arm injury against Indiana, while wide receiver Jeremiah Smith is described by ESPN as the Heisman front-runner.
At Michigan, coach Kyle Whittingham fired offensive coordinator Jason Beck after a 15-6 loss to Michigan State on Nov. 7, and the offense has stayed anemic.

quiz.q: Who is favored in Michigan at Ohio State?
quiz.why: Ohio State is a 10.5-point favorite.

stories.label: BREAKING
name: CHRIS
CREIGHTON
stories.title: Eastern Michigan fires Chris Creighton after 13 seasons
stories.dek: The school's second-winningest coach is out a day after the Eagles beat Kent State, and a national search has begun.
body: Eastern Michigan fired football coach Chris Creighton on Wednesday after 13 seasons, the school confirmed in a statement from athletic director Scott Wetherbee.
The move came a day after the Eagles beat Kent State 17-12 on Tuesday night. USA TODAY Sports reports the program has had four straight losing seasons since a nine-win year in 2022.

Creighton went 66-90 at Eastern Michigan and is the program's second-winningest coach. After a 3-21 start over his first two seasons, the Eagles went to bowl games in six of the next eight years; before him, the school had made only one bowl appearance.
Eastern Michigan said it will begin a national search for its next coach right away. No interim coach was named in the report.

stories.label: BREAKING
name: SONNY
DYKES
stories.title: TCU fires coach Sonny Dykes after a loss to No. 2 Utah
stories.dek: The Horned Frogs fell to 5-6; Dykes led them to the 2023 national title game.
body: TCU fired Sonny Dykes the morning after a 38-17 home loss to No. 2 Utah that dropped the Horned Frogs to 5-6. Dykes was 41-23 over five seasons and led TCU to the 2023 CFP title game in his first year.
Sources told ESPN he is expected to be owed more than $20 million. Defensive coordinator Andy Avalos is the interim coach for the regular-season finale against No. 12 Texas Tech.

quiz.q: Which team beat TCU 38-17 right before Dykes was fired?
quiz.why: No. 2 Utah beat TCU 38-17.

stories.label: DEBATE
name: JEREMIAH
SMITH
stories.title: Heisman race: Jeremiah Smith is the front-runner as Wake Forest QB Gio Lopez makes a late push
stories.dek: ESPN's latest look at the race heading into the final weekend of the regular season.
body: ESPN calls Ohio State receiver Jeremiah Smith the Heisman Trophy front-runner.
ESPN's Bill Connelly writes that Wake Forest quarterback Gio Lopez is making a late push. Wake Forest is 10-1 and ranked No. 8 in the CFP rankings.

stories.label: DEBATE
stories.title: Houston leaps seven spots to No. 1 in the AP poll
stories.dek: The Cougars won the Players Era 8 tournament and took 55 of 59 first-place votes.
body: Houston jumped seven spots to No. 1 in the AP men's college basketball poll released Monday, after winning three games in three days at the Players Era 8 tournament in Las Vegas.
The Cougars beat then-No. 1 Florida in the semifinals and also beat Kansas that week. They received 55 of 59 first-place votes, ahead of Virginia, which is 7-0 and moved up to No. 2.
Four of last week's top five teams lost, which is why the top of the poll changed so much. Florida slipped to No. 3, Illinois moved to No. 4 and Texas Tech is No. 5.

poll.q: Who should be No. 1 right now?

stories.label: DRAMA
stories.title: Illinois beats Duke 99-78 and Duke drops out of the top 10
stories.dek: Duke has lost twice this season and now sits outside the AP top 10.
body: Illinois beat Duke 99-78 last week, and the win helped move the Illini up to No. 4 in the new AP poll.
It was Duke's second loss of the season. Duke and Michigan State both fell out of the top 10 in Monday's poll.
Duke is scheduled to play at UConn at 6 p.m. CT tonight.

stories.label: ANALYSIS
stories.title: Defending champion Michigan falls out of the AP poll
stories.dek: Arkansas dropped out too, while Indiana and Memphis entered the rankings.
body: Reigning national champion Michigan dropped out of the AP Top 25 entirely this week, along with Arkansas.
Indiana and Memphis both entered the poll, and Tennessee jumped from 14th to ninth after beating Michigan State 61-46.
BYU also keeps climbing. The 5-0 Cougars moved up two spots to No. 19.

stories.label: DEVELOPING
stories.title: No. 16 Duke beats No. 10 UConn 77-63 behind John Blackwell's 25
stories.dek: Duke's first win over a ranked team this season came in Las Vegas. Grand Canyon beat Colorado 79-73 to win a tournament title.
body: John Blackwell scored 25 points, 20 of them after halftime, as No. 16 Duke beat No. 10 UConn 77-63 in Las Vegas in a rematch of last season's Elite Eight. Duke led 38-32 at the break and outscored UConn 39-31 in the second half.
It is Duke's first win over a ranked opponent this season, days after an Illinois loss knocked the Blue Devils out of the top 10. UConn has now lost two in a row.

Also Wednesday: Grand Canyon beat Colorado 79-73 in their tournament championship game, Wake Forest beat Mississippi State 78-71 to set up a title game with Memphis on Friday, and VCU edged Washington 80-78. Earlier, Arizona beat Ole Miss 84-73 for a title, Xavier held off Texas A&M 88-83, USC edged South Carolina 71-69 and BYU beat Providence 85-82.
On Thursday, Cincinnati beat Georgia 83-81 in Kissimmee, Florida, and Texas meets Georgetown in a tournament semifinal.
